training.weight_cap_note: sqrt damping is applied as specified; the clamp ceiling is lowered from 10.0 to 3.0. The sweep showed cap 10 keeps validation loss climbing to 1.63 while cap 3 holds it at 1.19 for an equivalent validation macro ROC-AUC (0.7929 vs 0.7917).

regularization_note: input_dropout=0.30 drops raw Morgan bits and trunk dropout is raised to 0.50. With 6,259 training molecules against a 2,053-dim sparse input the earlier 0.30/no-input-dropout setting memorised the training set by epoch 5 (train loss 0.016, val loss 2.22, best epoch 1). See reports/regularization_sweep.csv.
